thread:
alex_ml: Kicking off canary for rwd-v4b-int4. Shadow showed small MRR drift and longdoc halluc bump. Proposing bayesian early-stop + sentinel throttle instead of flat rollback.

maya_prod: Sounds reasonable. What are the rules?

zheng_research: Draft rules:
```
stat: bayesian
metric: MRR
rollback_prob: 0.95 (P(delta < -0.01))
ess_min: 300
sentinels: longdoc(hall), codegen(mrr), short-answer(latency)
sentinel_actions: throttle_slice_to_0, reduce_share_10pct
```
If longdoc hall > baseline +1.5pp for 2 consecutive windows -> throttle longdoc and hold global rollout.

eli_infra: I'll implement adaptive throttle with geometric backoff (factor 0.5) and per-slice cooldown 30m. Will emit bayes_p metric per slice.

sara_sre: Paging rules: p999 +500ms or longdoc hall +3.0pp -> page. Otherwise alert channel.

maya_prod: Add noisy-slice guard: if a slice causes >50% of failures but has <5% traffic, require manual review.

zheng_research: We'll save posterior snapshots (mean, 90% CI, ESS) for audit and run an offline longdoc rerun after ~1k longdoc samples.

canary-bot: rollout.start: canary rwd-v4b-int4 @ 2026-03-23T08:45:11Z (2%). Monitoring window open.

alex_ml: Thanks all — pushing policy. Ping infra if you need extra metrics.
